output: Scientific Hypothesis: There is no significant relationship between time preference factors (such as DISSAVED and SAMESAVE) and BMI in the 1989 data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79). This hypothesis is based on the weak correlations observed between these variables and BMI, as well as the lack of statistical significance in the regression analysis due to the absence of p-values. The variables DISSAVED and SAMESAVE, which represent time preference behaviors, do not show a strong or statistically significant association with BMI in this dataset.
